insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured + Booster+ Sum Insured + Safeguard/Safeguard+ Sum Insured (exact amounts as per Policy Schedule)

great.name: Room rent: No limit / any room (default benefit)
great.quote: We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.
great.explanation: Default wording indicates no room rent capping (you can choose any room). This avoids proportionate deductions due to room category limits (unless you opt into a room-type modification).

great.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer (Booster+ + Safeguard/Safeguard+ sequence)
great.quote: Sum Insured will be utilized as per following sequence in event of any claim: 1. Base Sum Insured 2. Booster+ Sum Insured 3. Safeguard/Safeguard+ Sum Insured
great.explanation: Policy provides additional Sum Insured layers that can be used after Base Sum Insured is utilized, improving claim-paying capacity over time.

great.name: Restore / refill benefit: Unlimited reinstatement after first paid claim (ReAssure “Forever” / ReAssureX)
great.quote: Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure “Forever”. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.
great.explanation: Acts like an unlimited restore/reinstatement once triggered, allowing multiple future claims. Note: per the wording, max payout for any single claim is up to Base Sum Insured, but the refill can trigger unlimited times across claims.

good.name: PED waiting period: 36 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: 36 months PED waiting is within the 2–4 year industry-standard band.

good.name: Specific disease/procedure waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: 24 months is standard for specified illnesses.

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (illness)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident, provided the same are covered.
good.explanation: 30 days initial waiting is standard for health insurance.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization: 180 days only (not >180 days)
bad.quote: We will pay expenses incurred on consultations, medicines, physiotherapy, diagnostic tests for 60 days before the date of admission and 180 days after date of discharge
bad.explanation: Post-hospitalization is capped at 180 days. As per the scoring rules, GREAT requires >180 days; 180 days is not GREAT, and is treated as a red-flag here only because anything <60 is BAD and 60-180 is GOOD—this is at the upper end but still capped.

unclear.name: Co-pay (percentage and when it applies) not specified in this extract
unclear.quote: Co-Payment: It is the percentage of admissible claim amount You would have to bear, Rest we will pay.
unclear.explanation: The policy defines co-pay but does not state the actual co-pay % / triggers in the provided text. Verify in Policy Schedule / plan option chosen.

unclear.name: NCB / Renewal bonus (Sum Insured growth at renewal) not clearly defined as NCB
unclear.quote: Cumulative Bonus means any increase or addition in the Sum Insured granted by the insurer without an associated increase in premium
unclear.explanation: A definition is present, but the actual NCB/renewal bonus rate, cap, and whether it resets on claim are not provided in the shared extract. (Booster+ and Safeguard are separate benefits, not necessarily NCB).

unclear.name: Consumables / non-payable items coverage depends on Safeguard/Safeguard+ choice (not default-clear)
unclear.quote: Claim Safeguard: We will cover non-payable items mentioned in ‘List I – Expenses not covered’ of Annexure I’... Claim Safeguard+: We will cover non-payable items mentioned in ‘List I,II,III,IV of Annexure I’.
unclear.explanation: Consumables coverage exists if Safeguard/Safeguard+ is chosen, but the extract does not confirm whether Safeguard/Safeguard+ is included by default in your plan or is optional. Confirm in the Policy Schedule/variant selected.

unclear.name: Restore benefit classification: whether it covers same illness and exact mechanics for every claim needs schedule confirmation
unclear.quote: Maximum amount ReAssure+ pays for any single claim is up to Base Sum Insured.
unclear.explanation: Unlimited reinstatement is described, but per-claim cap and triggering rules (first paid claim) can affect how restore works in practice. Confirm exact applicability for your chosen variant (ReAssure+ vs ReAssureX) in schedule.

unclear.name: Cashless network size (hospital count) not stated
unclear.quote: Cashless claim facility is available at our network hospitals ONLY. As list of network hospitals is dynamic, for the latest list, refer to our website www.nivabupa.com.
unclear.explanation: Network is mentioned but number of cashless hospitals is not specified in the wording shared; verify current network strength on insurer website.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
